name: short
comment: 60-90s-target cut for the LinkedIn feed. Three contiguous windows, so only two seams. Each window opens 0.3 s before its first spoken line, so the scene is already drawn (opening on the scene boundary instead gave a near-black first frame) and no speech is clipped; each ends on a scene's tail hold rather than mid-sentence. Keeps the graph-is-generated claim, the whole safety argument and its test, the suspend/approve/apply arc, the limits and the end card. Drops the intro, 'writes back', the zone read, the first dry run, the live map and the decline branch - all still in the full version.
